items.scene:
Narrator: Hans and his wife, Ann, and their daughter, Olga, walk to a town. They see a woman.

Hans: We're very hungry, says Hans. Do you have any food?

Woman: No, says the woman. I'm hungry, too!

Narrator: They see a man.

Olga: Olga says, We're hungry. Do you have any food?

Man: No, says the man. I'm hungry, too!

Narrator: The family has a big pot. Hans puts water in it. Ann and Olga look for stones. They each find four stones and put them into the pot.

Woman and her friend: What's that? ask the woman and her friend.

Hans: It's stone soup, says Hans. It's tasty. You can try some, but we don't have any potatoes. It's good with potatoes.

Woman: I have five! says the woman.

Woman's friend: I have seven, says her friend.

Narrator: They put the potatoes into the pot.

Man and his son: What's that? ask the man and his son.

Olga: It's stone soup, says Olga. It's tasty. You can try some, but we don't have any sausages. It's good with sausages.

Man: I have two, says the man.

Son: I have three, says his son.

Narrator: They put the sausages into the pot. Later, the people from the town smell the soup and come out to look.

Townspeople: We have onions. We have carrots, they say, and put them into the pot.

Narrator: Everyone eats some soup.

Townspeople: We didn't have enough food, say the people. But we added our food together and now we all have tasty soup!
